name: nikyn-portfolio
description: Full-stack portfolio for Nikyn V S

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm start --prefix backend"
scripts.deploy: npm run build --prefix frontend && git add -f frontend/dist && git commit -m 'Deploy build' --allow-empty && git push origin $(git subtree split --prefix frontend/dist main):refs/heads/gh-pages --force
scripts.install-all: npm install --cache ./.npm-cache && npm install --cache ./frontend/.npm-cache --prefix frontend && npm install --cache ./backend/.npm-cache --prefix backend
